title: Forgotten Victories: History India Was Taught | Sanjeev Sanyal | #SangamTalks
author: Sangam Talks
desc_snippet:
Sanjeev Sanyal reveals why he believes the Indian history taught in textbooks is largely the history of foreign invaders, and what the record looks like when told from India's own side. Discover the battles India won that few textbooks mention, & learn how the Ashoka the Great story compares with the inscriptions and texts it is built on.  Essential viewing for history students, teachers and curious readers seeking to question inherited narratives and examine the primary evidence for themselves.
